column3: “King Darius” follows the Hebrew order variant; NASB adds “which is” before “Chislev.”
“Bethel had sent” is rendered “the town of Bethel had sent,” supplying “the town of”; “entreat the face” is rendered “seek the favor.” The meaning of the sentence is uncertain.
“Consecrate myself” is rendered “abstain,” and “how many years” “these many years.”
“Really did you fast for me, me?” is rendered “was it actually for Me that you fasted?”
“Are you not the ones who eat” is rendered “do you not eat for yourselves.”
“By the hand of” is rendered “by,” “remaining” “inhabited,” “at ease” “prosperous,” and “the Shephelah” “the foothills.”
“Justice of faithfulness judge” is rendered “Dispense true justice,” and “loyalty” “kindness.”
“Fatherless” is rendered “orphan,” and “sojourner” “stranger”; “the harm of each his brother” is rendered “evil … against one another.”
“Made flint” is rendered “made … like flint”; “by the hand of” is rendered “through,” and NASB adds “therefore.”
“Did not listen” is rendered “would not listen.”
“I will storm them away” is rendered “I scattered them with a storm wind,” and “land of desire” “pleasant land.”
